cases.input: One raw lot is split into two successor lots.
cases.expect: Successors L-a and L-b carry distinct issuer-qualified identities, lineage.kind = split, lineage.predecessorRefs = [L], proportionBasis stated with unit; L retains its identity and its residual quantity.

cases.input: Ten serialized assemblies are produced from one lot.
cases.expect: S1..S10 each retain WM-OBJ-001 identity and carry lot-of-origin provenance referencing L; no item identity is derived from L and L does not decompose into ten instances.

cases.input: One lot is affected while same-SKU units from other lots have no event-backed link.
cases.expect: Exposure set = {proven: S1..S10 via event-backed output edges of T}, {potential: blended co-product lot, reasonCode: mass-balance-commingled}, {notEvidenced: all same-SKU units of other lots}; recallDecisionRef is absent and no SKU-level scope is emitted.

cases.input: All units with one SKU are treated as the same lot.
cases.expect: The identity merge is rejected.

cases.input: A warehouse stock position is used as lot identity.
cases.expect: The inference is rejected.

cases.input: BOM membership alone proves actual lot composition.
cases.expect: The claim is rejected.

cases.input: Lot L holds 1000 kg net. Transformation T consumes 400 kg. No other event touches L.
cases.expect: L retains identity, consumption state partially-consumed, residual.quantity 600, residual.unit kg, residual.basis net, residual.asOfRecordTime set, derivation declared; L is not closed or exhausted.

cases.input: Lots L1 (300 kg) and L2 (200 kg) are merged into a single lot L3.
cases.expect: L3 carries a new issuer-qualified identity, lineage.kind merge, lineage.predecessorRefs [L1,L2], proportionBasis 300 kg and 200 kg with unit, proportionMethod measured, edgeAssertionClass asserted; L1 and L2 retain identity with residual 0 and consumption state exhausted.

cases.input: Lot L and lot M are blended in a silo; the resulting co-product lot C cannot be apportioned by measurement.
cases.expect: C carries lineage.kind blend, predecessorRefs [L,M], proportionMethod mass-balance-inferred and edgeAssertionClass inferred; the inferred lineage is never emitted as asserted and never establishes one-to-one continuity.

cases.input: A lot is created with quantityBasis and unit but no quantityScope.
cases.expect: Creation is refused for a missing quantity scope; no default grain is substituted.

cases.input: A closed lot identifier is reassigned to a newly produced lot by the same issuer.
cases.expect: Reassignment is refused; the identifier remains permanently bound to the retired lot.

cases.input: No stock row exists for lot L at site W; a balance report states L holds 0 at W.
cases.expect: The zero assertion is refused; the absent row resolves to unobserved and unknown, zero, not-applicable, withheld and suppressed remain distinct.

cases.input: Lot L is set to disposition recall-marked with no recallDecisionRef, on the strength of an exposure analysis.
cases.expect: The disposition change is refused for absent external recall authority; the exposure result is retained as analysis only.

cases.input: A lot is recorded with the single state released, and partially-consumed is rejected as inconsistent with it.
cases.expect: The single-axis encoding is refused; consumption and disposition must be valued independently and concurrently.

cases.input: A lot's expiry date is corrected by updating the existing version in place.
cases.expect: The in-place update is refused; a new versionId citing supersedesVersionRef is required and the prior version remains readable.

cases.input: A lot version is written with producedAt only and no recordTime.
cases.expect: The write is refused; record time is required and is never defaulted from effective or production time.

cases.input: A lot status change is asserted with no sourceSystem, assertingAgentRef, method or evidenceDigest.
cases.expect: The assertion is refused for absent provenance; an unprovenanced status change is not recorded as observed.

cases.input: A production-origin lot cites originRef as a free-text routing step identifier.
cases.expect: The origin is refused; a production origin must cite the identifier-unassigned Transformation Event candidate and must not cite BOM or routing.

cases.input: Serialized item S7 is addressed by its lot membership alone as its item identity.
cases.expect: The substitution is refused; lot membership is provenance on the WM-OBJ-001 item and never resolves item identity.

cases.input: Lot L is read at a carrier hub, and the carrier is recorded as owner of L.
cases.expect: The ownership assertion is refused; location does not imply custody and custody does not imply title.
